description: Events by month, week or day: bookings, appointments, shifts, a team's leave. Multi-day events run as bars, overlapping ones sit side by side, busy days get a "more" list, and on a phone it becomes an agenda. All-day events keep their dates in any timezone; times show in the timezone you give, and ends are exclusive. views adds a switch between views, and the arrows change the period without reloading the page. Pass arrays, or your models with keys. Read-only: events can link to your pages. Works with Livewire.

consider.note: Everything passed to the calendar is in the page, whether it shows or not. Load only the events the person may see, filtered in the query (a policy or a scope), never by hiding them in the view, and leave private details out of the title on a calendar others can see. Titles and statuses are escaped, and an `href` that isn't a path or an http, https, mailto or tel address (such as `javascript:`) is dropped, so events people enter themselves can be shown as they are.

The date comes from the URL, so anyone can ask for any month, week or day. Load only what's shown, with `Calendar::range()` and an index on the start and end columns, and give `min` and `max` where dates outside them mean nothing, so a crawler following Next doesn't walk on for ever.
